Bug_Details: Members shouldn't be annotated with @Inject if constructor is already annotated @Inject
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the code by annotating the field `name` with `@Inject`, which is not allowed if the constructor is also annotated with `@Inject`.

Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the `showBug()` method on an instance of `InjectOnMemberAndConstructor`.
